task: Add a control-arm memory ISOLATION layer on top of main's B-ab8d experiment-arm render gate, closing the JSON/serialized surfaces the render gate leaves host-readable on the control arm.
outcome: On the control arm (LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ARM=control), the runtime memory pack is empty at every JSON/file serialization surface (done_closure/final_response_check/host_dispatch/handoff_create/handoff_resume/prefetch-manifest/playbook_runtime_health), final_response_check (the 8th RuntimeConsumer) suppresses its text render, parallel_dispatch injects no experienceRefs, and two corpus tools are refused. Treatment and no-experiment output is byte-identical to before.
facts: main's B-ab8d ships resolveExperimentArm (core/experiment-arm.ts, LATTICE_* env), surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack + experience_pack_surfaced (core/experience-pack-surface.ts), and memoryRetrieval markers (command-policy.ts).
B-ab8d suppresses only the TEXT render on control and deliberately keeps the pack in JSON for lossless measurement.
final_response_check (handlers/playbook-runtime-memory.ts) is the 8th RuntimeConsumer and was never routed through surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack by B-ab8d.
The experience_pack_surfaced event carries packDigest + topHitIds on both arms, so measurement does not need the JSON pack.
constraints: Key everything on the SAME resolveExperimentArm resolver (no second arm system).
Measurement must stay lossless (the JSON pack key is kept; only its CONTENT is emptied on control).
Treatment and no-experiment paths must be byte-identical no-ops.
unknowns: Whether any downstream analysis reads the JSON pack CONTENT rather than the experience_pack_surfaced event (verified: it uses the event).
